_note: A case type's question can be answered from the mail a case is made from, in OpenRegister's Mail panel. The template uses the placeholders of a schema's mailObjectTemplate ({{subject}}, {{sender}}, {{senderName}}, {{date}}, {{preview}} and the rest). A fragment rather than an edit to dossiq_register.json, per ADR-037.

mailValue.title: Answer from a mail
mailValue.description: What this field is filled with when a case is made from a mail, written with the mail's placeholders, for example {{senderName}} or {{subject}}. The person can still change it. Empty leaves the field for the person to fill in.
